nodes.name: Literary Arts
nodes.description: The art of written and oral language composition, encompassing poetry, fiction, nonfiction, and drama.

nodes.name: Poetry
nodes.description: Language art using rhythm, imagery, and compression to evoke meaning and feeling.

nodes.name: Epic Poetry
nodes.description: Long narrative poetry recounting heroic deeds and foundational events.

nodes.name: Lyric Poetry
nodes.description: Short poetry expressing personal emotion, often song-like.

nodes.name: Narrative Poetry
nodes.description: Poetry that tells a story with plot and characters.

nodes.name: Sonnet
nodes.description: A fourteen-line poem in fixed rhyme scheme, notably Petrarchan and Shakespearean.

nodes.name: Ode
nodes.description: A formal lyric poem of praise or meditation.

nodes.name: Elegy
nodes.description: A poem of lament, usually for the dead.

nodes.name: Ballad
nodes.description: A narrative poem or song of folk origin, often in quatrains.

nodes.name: Haiku
nodes.description: Japanese three-line poem of seventeen syllables capturing a fleeting moment.

nodes.name: Tanka
nodes.description: Japanese five-line poem of thirty-one syllables.

nodes.name: Free Verse
nodes.description: Poetry without fixed meter or rhyme.

nodes.name: Ghazal
nodes.description: A lyric form of rhyming couplets and refrain, of Arabic and Persian origin.

nodes.name: Limerick
nodes.description: A five-line humorous poem with an AABBA rhyme scheme.

nodes.name: Villanelle
nodes.description: A nineteen-line poem of two rhymes and repeated refrains.

nodes.name: Prose Poetry
nodes.description: Poetry written in prose form without line breaks.

nodes.name: Concrete Poetry
nodes.description: Poetry in which visual arrangement of words is part of meaning.

nodes.name: Slam Poetry
nodes.description: Competitive performance poetry judged by audience response.

nodes.name: Prose Fiction
nodes.description: Imaginative narrative written in prose.

nodes.name: Novel
nodes.description: A long prose narrative of substantial plot and character development.

nodes.name: Literary Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction valued for artistic merit, style, and depth of character.

nodes.name: Science Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction exploring imagined science, technology, and futures.

nodes.name: Fantasy
nodes.description: Fiction of magic, myth, and imaginary worlds.

nodes.name: Mystery
nodes.description: Fiction centered on the solving of a crime or puzzle.

nodes.name: Romance Novel
nodes.description: Fiction centered on love and emotional relationships.

nodes.name: Horror Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction evoking fear and dread.

nodes.name: Thriller
nodes.description: Suspenseful fiction driven by tension and high stakes.

nodes.name: Historical Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction set in a researched historical period.

nodes.name: Crime Fiction
nodes.description: Fiction about criminals, detectives, and the justice system.

nodes.name: Short Story
nodes.description: A brief prose narrative focused on a single effect or episode.

nodes.name: Novella
nodes.description: A prose narrative between a short story and a novel in length.

nodes.name: Flash Fiction
nodes.description: Extremely short fiction, often under a thousand words.

nodes.name: Nonfiction
nodes.description: Factual writing in literary form.

nodes.name: Essay
nodes.description: A short prose reflection on a subject from a personal viewpoint.

nodes.name: Biography
nodes.description: An account of a person's life written by another.

nodes.name: Autobiography
nodes.description: An account of a person's life written by themselves.

nodes.name: Memoir
nodes.description: A personal narrative focused on memory and experience.

nodes.name: Travel Writing
nodes.description: Writing about places, journeys, and cultures encountered.

nodes.name: Creative Nonfiction
nodes.description: Factual prose employing literary techniques of fiction.

nodes.name: Drama Literature
nodes.description: Plays written as literary texts for performance.

nodes.name: Oral Literature
nodes.description: Verbal art transmitted orally across generations.

nodes.name: Folktale
nodes.description: Traditional anonymous story passed down orally.

nodes.name: Myth
nodes.description: Sacred narrative explaining origins and cosmic order.

nodes.name: Fable
nodes.description: Short tale with a moral, often featuring animals.

nodes.name: Legend
nodes.description: Traditional story of human heroes rooted in historical memory.

nodes.name: Children's Literature
nodes.description: Literature written for or read by children.

nodes.name: Chinese Classical Literature
nodes.description: The literary canon of China in classical Chinese, spanning three millennia.

nodes.name: Shi Poetry
nodes.description: Regulated and ancient-style Chinese verse, including Tang poetry.

nodes.name: Ci Poetry
nodes.description: Chinese lyric poetry set to tune patterns, flourishing in the Song dynasty.

nodes.name: Fu
nodes.description: Chinese rhapsody of ornate prose-poetry.

nodes.name: Classical Chinese Prose
nodes.description: Literary prose in classical Chinese, including essays and histories.

nodes.name: Chinese Vernacular Fiction
nodes.description: Ming-Qing novels and tales written in vernacular Chinese.

nodes.name: Japanese Classical Literature
nodes.description: The premodern literary tradition of Japan.

nodes.name: Waka
nodes.description: Classical Japanese court poetry, the ancestor of tanka.

nodes.name: Monogatari
nodes.description: Japanese prose narrative tradition, including court tales.

nodes.name: Zuihitsu
nodes.description: Japanese miscellany essay following the brush.

nodes.name: Haikai
nodes.description: Comic linked-verse tradition from which haiku emerged.

nodes.name: Sanskrit Literature
nodes.description: The classical literature of ancient and medieval India in Sanskrit.

nodes.name: Kavya
nodes.description: Ornate Sanskrit courtly poetry.

nodes.name: Sanskrit Epic
nodes.description: The great Sanskrit epics and their narrative tradition.

nodes.name: Sanskrit Drama
nodes.description: Classical Indian theater in Sanskrit.

nodes.name: Persian Literature
nodes.description: The literary tradition of Persian, renowned for its poetry.

nodes.name: Masnavi
nodes.description: Persian narrative poem in rhyming couplets.

nodes.name: Rubai
nodes.description: Persian quatrain form made famous by Omar Khayyam.

nodes.name: Arabic Literature
nodes.description: The literary tradition of the Arabic language.

nodes.name: Qasida
nodes.description: Classical Arabic ode of unified meter and rhyme.

nodes.name: Maqama
nodes.description: Arabic rhymed prose narrative of eloquent rogues.
